articles.title: How to keep a milk diary
articles.summary: Make a passbook for each farmer or customer, write the litres of the day for everyone on one screen, and print the fortnightly or monthly statement.

articles.title: Next period, balances and statements
articles.summary: Start the next fortnight or month for everyone in one tap with the balance carried forward, see who is owed and who owes, and send statements on WhatsApp.
